title: Accurate Residues for Floating-Point Debugging
summary: Floating-point arithmetic is error-prone and unintuitive. Floating-point debuggers instrument programs to monitor floating-point arithmetic at run time and flag numerical issues. They estimate residues, i.e., the difference between actual floating-point and ideal real values, for every floating-point value in the program. Prior work explores various approaches for computing these residues accurately and efficiently.
